nodes.title: Neural Networks
nodes.summary: Artificial neural networks mimic the human brain using interconnected nodes to learn patterns from data and make predictions in AI systems.

nodes.title: Deep Learning Models
nodes.summary: Deep learning models with multiple hidden layers can automatically extract complex features from large datasets like images and text.

nodes.title: Machine Learning Algorithms
nodes.summary: Machine learning algorithms such as decision trees, SVM, and random forests allow computers to identify patterns and make intelligent predictions.

nodes.title: AI Ethics
nodes.summary: AI ethics ensures fairness, transparency, and accountability in machine learning systems, preventing bias and misuse of algorithms.

nodes.title: Reinforcement Learning
nodes.summary: Reinforcement learning enables agents to make sequential decisions through rewards and penalties, used in robotics and game AI.

nodes.title: Natural Language Processing
nodes.summary: NLP enables machines to understand and generate human language using models like transformers and LSTMs.

nodes.title: React Framework
nodes.summary: React is a JavaScript library for building reusable UI components, improving performance through a virtual DOM.

nodes.title: REST APIs
nodes.summary: REST APIs use HTTP methods to allow communication between client and server in a stateless, scalable architecture.

nodes.title: Frontend Development
nodes.summary: Frontend development focuses on building responsive, interactive web interfaces using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

nodes.title: Web Authentication
nodes.summary: Web authentication techniques such as JWT and OAuth ensure secure login and session management in modern web applications.

nodes.title: Backend Frameworks
nodes.summary: Backend frameworks like Django, Flask, and Node.js handle routing, databases, and API management for scalable web services.

nodes.title: Progressive Web Apps
nodes.summary: PWAs combine the reach of the web with the experience of native apps, offering offline support and push notifications.

nodes.title: Data Visualization
nodes.summary: Data visualization tools like Matplotlib and Seaborn help convert data into graphical insights for better decision-making.

nodes.title: Data Cleaning
nodes.summary: Data cleaning involves handling missing values, removing duplicates, and transforming data for analysis.

nodes.title: Feature Engineering
nodes.summary: Feature engineering creates meaningful variables that improve the performance of predictive models.

nodes.title: Exploratory Data Analysis
nodes.summary: EDA involves summarizing data and visualizing trends to discover underlying patterns and anomalies.

nodes.title: Time Series Analysis
nodes.summary: Time series analysis examines data points collected over time to forecast trends using models like ARIMA or LSTM.

nodes.title: Data Pipelines
nodes.summary: Data pipelines automate data collection, cleaning, and transformation for analytics and machine learning workflows.

nodes.title: Cybersecurity Fundamentals
nodes.summary: Cybersecurity protects systems and networks from unauthorized access and data breaches using firewalls and encryption.

nodes.title: Phishing Attacks
nodes.summary: Phishing attacks deceive users into sharing confidential information by impersonating trusted entities online.

nodes.title: Network Security
nodes.summary: Network security ensures safe data transmission using VPNs, intrusion detection, and secure protocols like HTTPS.

nodes.title: Web3 Security
nodes.summary: Web3 security focuses on protecting decentralized apps and smart contracts from exploits and vulnerabilities.

nodes.title: Penetration Testing
nodes.summary: Pen testing simulates cyberattacks to identify weaknesses in systems and networks before hackers can exploit them.

nodes.title: Cloud Security
nodes.summary: Cloud security protects cloud-based infrastructure, ensuring compliance and data protection in remote environments.

nodes.title: Blockchain Basics
nodes.summary: Blockchain is a decentralized ledger system that stores transactions securely using cryptographic techniques.

nodes.title: Smart Contracts
nodes.summary: Smart contracts automatically execute terms of an agreement without intermediaries, running on blockchain platforms.

nodes.title: Decentralized Applications
nodes.summary: DApps operate on peer-to-peer blockchain networks, allowing transparent and censorship-resistant transactions.

nodes.title: Cryptocurrency
nodes.summary: Cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin and Ethereum are digital assets that use cryptography for secure transactions and value transfer.

nodes.title: DeFi Platforms
nodes.summary: DeFi uses blockchain to offer decentralized financial services like lending and trading without intermediaries.

nodes.title: NFT Technology
nodes.summary: Non-fungible tokens represent digital ownership of unique assets on a blockchain, used in art, gaming, and collectibles.
